About the freelancer: 5 years experience; skills: SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboard, data cleaning, data visualization

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: eCommerce Test Buy (20mins work) UAE only - Ticket 68290
[Please include "I have a local delivery address in the UAE" in the first line of your response to show that you have read and fully understood the requirements].Hello,We are conducting research on eCommerce channels and eCommerce sellers around customer service, product delivery times, packaging quality, and delivered product condition.We are looking for people with experience in online shopping who have the ability to receive delivery of items to your address in order to test and share results against the above-mentioned parameters.This task will be broken down into the following milestones:Milestone 1. Order PlacementStep 1 - Place an order on the eCommerce channel using the provided URL with the credit card details providedStep 2 - Take a screenshot to show successful order confirmation and submit this to us.Step 3 - Share the order confirmation numberMilestone 2. Physical ProductStep 1 - Confirm receipt of the order by submitting a digital image of the packaging slip/order identifier.Step 2 - Submit an image of the external packaging, the product inside the packaging (if multipack please take pictures of ONE individual pack inside), the front, back, and both sides of the product (ensuring the capture of legible images of all Serial Numbers, Barcodes, Expiry Dates, Batch Number, the Sender Address, SKUs, etc.).Step 3 - Hold onto the item, without using it or making any alterations to the condition it arrives in, for a period of 3 days (7 for the UAE) before we confirm it

text:
I have a local delivery address in the UAE and can handle the full test-buy process, from placing the order to documenting the delivery and packaging condition exactly as requested.

With 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization, I’m comfortable working carefully and following structured reporting steps.

In my marketing attribution analysis for Verdant Skincare, I built a BigQuery/SQL workflow that joined ad spend with GA4 sessions to compare attribution models; it helped reallocate 18% of ad budget and reduced CAC by 12% the next quarter. In my A/B test readouts for Hearthstone Games, I built a repeatable experiment readout template with power checks before launch; 11 experiments were analysed and 2 underpowered tests were stopped early.

I can complete this task accurately and provide the required screenshots and images on time.
